strings.zh: 最近红莲岛的火山灰{NEWLINE}飘到这一带影响了海面上的视线。{CLEAR}安全起见,{CLEAR}前方的水路暂时禁止通行。
strings.en: Recently, volcanic ash from Cinnabar{NEWLINE}Island has drifted over here and ruined{CLEAR}visibility out at sea. For safety’s sake,{CLEAR}the sea route ahead is closed for now.

strings.zh: 前边那个小伙子嚷嚷着{NEWLINE}要让皮卡丘冲浪穿过大海。{CLEAR}真是好笑啊,皮卡丘这种电系精灵{CLEAR}怎么可能学会冲浪呢！
strings.en: That kid up ahead keeps shouting{NEWLINE}that he’s going to have his Pikachu{CLEAR}surf across the sea. What a joke!{CLEAR}How could an Electric type{CLEAR}like Pikachu ever learn Surf!

strings.zh: 火山灰终于散去了,{NEWLINE}这下19号水路可以通行了。
strings.en: The volcanic ash has finally cleared.{NEWLINE}Route 19’s sea route is open now.

strings.zh: 太惊人了！那个皮卡丘{NEWLINE}居然把电力具象成了冲浪板,{CLEAR}然后踏着海浪冲出去了！
strings.en: Incredible! That Pikachu turned its{NEWLINE}electricity into a surfboard and rode{CLEAR}off across the waves!

strings.zh: 这里是１９号水路{NEWLINE}南　双子岛
strings.en: Rt. 19 Fuchsia City to{NEWLINE}Seafoam Islands

strings.zh: 有张传单！{SCROLL}要游去双子岛的人{NEWLINE}请一定要格外小心！{CLEAR}　　　　……浅红市警察
strings.en: What’s this notice?{SCROLL}Please be careful if you are swimming{NEWLINE}to Seafoam Islands.{CLEAR}Fuchsia Police

strings.zh: 你好,我正在跟皮卡丘练习冲浪。{NEWLINE}人人都说皮卡丘学不会冲浪,{CLEAR}但是我因为长久跟皮卡丘相处,{CLEAR}发现了它学会冲浪的可能性。{SCROLL}我相信有朝一日{NEWLINE}皮卡丘能带着我一起冲过大海,{CLEAR}把这面海滩旗插到{CLEAR}19号路南端的小沙滩上。{SCROLL}可惜浅红市周围的海面相对平静,{NEWLINE}要让皮卡丘练习冲浪的话,{CLEAR}得有大一点的海浪才行。{CLEAR}如果有比雕这种大型鸟类{CLEAR}在南端的小沙滩上不断卷起暴风,{CLEAR}应该就能产生足够大的海浪了。
strings.en: Hi! I’m practicing Surf with my Pikachu.{NEWLINE}Everyone says Pikachu can’t learn Surf,{CLEAR}but after spending so long with my{CLEAR}Pikachu, I found out it just might be{CLEAR}able to.{SCROLL}I believe that someday, Pikachu will{NEWLINE}carry me across the sea, and I’ll plant{CLEAR}this beach flag on the little beach at{CLEAR}the south end of Route 19.{SCROLL}Sadly, the sea around Fuchsia City is{NEWLINE}pretty calm. For Pikachu to practice{CLEAR}surfing, we need bigger waves. If a big{CLEAR}bird like Pidgeot kept whipping up gales{CLEAR}on the little beach at the south end,{CLEAR}that should make big enough waves.
strings.notes: Surfing Pikachu side quest (#6–#27): needs a Pidgeot (#8) on the south beach

strings.zh: 皮卡丘『Pika,Pika！
strings.en: Pikachu: Pika, pika!

strings.zh: 现在正好带着比雕,{NEWLINE}要让比雕对着海面扇起暴风吗？
strings.en: You happen to have Pidgeot with you.{NEWLINE}Have Pidgeot whip up{CLEAR}a gale over the sea?

strings.zh: 比雕『Piii——dgeo！
strings.en: Pidgeot: Piii-dgeo!

strings.zh: 海面上好像有什么冲过来了！
strings.en: Something’s racing toward us across{NEWLINE}the sea!

strings.zh: 皮卡丘！成功了！{NEWLINE}咱们成功了！！！！{CLEAR}长久以来的努力终于有了结果！
strings.en: Pikachu! We did it! We did it!!!! All our{NEWLINE}hard work has finally paid off!

strings.zh: 是你的比雕帮忙卷起的海浪吗？{NEWLINE}太谢谢你了！{CLEAR}多亏了这个漂亮的海浪,{CLEAR}我的皮卡丘才能顺利地掌握冲浪技术。{SCROLL}如果你也有皮卡丘{NEWLINE}并且想让它学习冲浪的话,{CLEAR}就来找我吧。{SCROLL}我会把皮卡丘冲浪的技巧{NEWLINE}尽数教给它的。
strings.en: Was that your Pidgeot making those{NEWLINE}waves? Thank you so much! Thanks to{CLEAR}those beautiful waves, my Pikachu{CLEAR}finally mastered surfing.{SCROLL}If you have a Pikachu too and want it to{NEWLINE}learn Surf, come see me.{SCROLL}I’ll teach it every Pikachu surfing trick{NEWLINE}I know.

strings.zh: 如果你也有皮卡丘{NEWLINE}并且想让它学习冲浪的话,{CLEAR}就来找我吧。{SCROLL}我会把皮卡丘冲浪的技巧{NEWLINE}尽数教给它的。{SCROLL}要让皮卡丘学习冲浪吗？
strings.en: If you have a Pikachu too and want it to{NEWLINE}learn Surf, come see me.{SCROLL}I’ll teach it every Pikachu surfing trick{NEWLINE}I know.{SCROLL}Do you want your Pikachu to learn Surf?

strings.zh: 如果想学的话随时欢迎来找我。
strings.en: If you want to learn it, come see me{NEWLINE}anytime.

strings.zh: 来,让我看看你的皮卡丘。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Okay, let me see your Pikachu.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你这只精灵不是皮卡丘啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: This Pokémon isn’t a Pikachu.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你这是精灵蛋,不是皮卡丘啊。
strings.en: That’s a Pokémon Egg, not a Pikachu.

strings.zh: 这只{VAR:0100:0}{NEWLINE}已经学会冲浪术了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: This {VAR:0100:0} already knows Surf!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0101:0}想要记住{NEWLINE}新的冲浪……！{SCROLL}但是{VAR:0101:0}{NEWLINE}已经记住4个技能了！{SCROLL}为了学习冲浪{NEWLINE}要让它忘记其他技能吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: {VAR:0101:0} wants to learn Surf...!{SCROLL}But {VAR:0101:0} already knows four{NEWLINE}moves!{SCROLL}Should it forget{NEWLINE}a move to learn Surf?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 忘记{VAR:0106:1},{NEWLINE}确定吗？{VAR:0200:0}

strings.en: My boyfriend and I are going to swim all{NEWLINE}the way to Fuchsia City!

strings.en: Don’t you think doing the same thing{NEWLINE}together really brings a couple closer?
